notes.title: Nominate Onde for the ‚Outstanding Visual Style‘ Steam Award 2022!
notes.notes:
Soundwave-riders!
[b]Are you enjoying Onde? Because, we need your support![/b]

If you appreciate the beautiful soundscape and outstanding visuals Onde has to offer, we'd be happy if you nominate our [b]Onde[/b] for the [b]‘Outstanding Visual Style' Steam Award 2022[/b]!

[u]And here's how you can vote for us:[/u]
[list][*] Either you simply use the nomination format above
[*] Or, simply head over to the Onde Apart Steam Store Page
[list][*] Click on 'Nominate this Game for an Award'
[*] Choose the ‘Outstanding Visual Style’-Award
[*] Hit 'Save' and you have nominated us for this year's ‘Outstanding Visual Style’![/list]
[*] Wish us luck! 🤞[/list]


[b]Thank you for your ongoing support![/b]


[i][b]- Your teams from Lance/3-50 & Assemble Entertainment[/b][/i]

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games!
notes.notes:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for Save & Sound. 

We'll share insights into the creation of Onde's living and breathing soundscapes, which are one of the game's main features (and perhaps even its secret stars). 

Make sure to tune in on Friday, July 15, 11 am PDT / 8 pm CEST to watch our session on Save & Sound's stream!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41023938/b35cef0001f0d3542c14cf5debbd13d56e201e64.png[/img]

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]

notes.title: The wait is finally over: Onde is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Salut everyone,

After five years in development, the time has finally come: [b]You can now get Onde for PC![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676910/Onde/

In all honesty, it is a little scary to see what has once started as a prototype at the Global Game Jam 2017 out in the wild. But it also feels great to see how far this game has come and to realize how much we've grown, too, in the course of the past five years. [b]We really hope you are going to like what Onde has evolved into![/b]

Here's a new trailer to celebrate the release – if you like it, leave a like, comment and/or share on your channels to make it seen:

[previewyoutube=Sfl32WxJhiw;full][/previewyoutube]

We'd also be grateful for any additional support you can give: A [b]review[/b] on Steam will help a lot in making Onde visible to other players, so it would be great if you could take a minute to leave your opinion. 

Last but not least: We'd like to say [b]THANK YOU[/b] for accompanying us on our journey – we wouldn't have been able to create Onde without you and we hope you'll find the experience of playing makes it worth your while!

We'd be happy to hear your impressions, so hit us up here or on our social channels if you want to share your thoughts!

Take care
Team Onde

P.S.: Onde's journey doesn't end here – stay tuned for future updates and information about the upcoming versions for Nintendo Switch and iOS!

notes.title: Watch us stream and talk about Onde
notes.notes:
We're happy to be part of the Steam Next Fest and hope you enjoy the updated demo of our smooth sound-surfing platformer! 

To celebrate the occasion, we're going live to show you the demo and talk about Onde's world filled with sound and wonders on [b]Friday February 25, 5pm CET / 8am PST[/b].


[b]About Onde:[/b]

Catch a wave in this smooth sound-surfing platformer: Let ethereal tunes carry you fluidly through serene abstract landscapes, tune into soothing sound spheres and revel in a meditative journey of life.

[list]
[*]smooth, intuitive puzzle-platforming: create ephemeral paths along waves of sound and light to follow your calling
[*]ethereal, adaptive soundscapes: conduct soothing sounds as you navigate through melodic environments
[*]meditative experience: organic movement, fluid gameplay and relaxing sounds make for a Zen-like journey
[*]a world filled with wonders: from the deep sea to space, explore manifold areas along your way, each sporting unique visuals and puzzle mechanics
[*]elegant abstract artwork: a serene world that changes from clear lines to swirls of color during this journey of life
[/list]

[b]Don't forget to add Onde to your wishlist:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676910/Onde/

notes.title: Onde lands on Steam
notes.notes:
[b]Salut everyone,[/b]

we are excited to finally be able to share the news with you:

Our game that has formerly been known as oQo is now called Onde (French for "wave") and we're happy to have a Steam page, a brand-new trailer and a fresh [url=https://onde-game.com]website[/url], as well!

[previewyoutube=0nAnZLKYbEc;full][/previewyoutube]

Onde is a sound-surfing platformer that lets you fluidly ride waves through a world filled with wonders.

We'd love for you to join the sound-surfing crowd and follow the rest of our journey – here, on [url=https://twitter.com/OndeGame]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://facebook.com/OndeGame]Facebook[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676910/Onde/

And for everyone who wants to try the game for themselves, we have one more piece of news: Onde is taking part in this year's Indie Arena Booth Online and will have a public demo live on Steam during the event – keep an eye out for that!

Take care
[i]Team Onde[/i]
